summary.text: NORDLYSPULKEN AS (996 306 127), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2010-11-16; address Arkitekt Adlers gate 5, 9980 BERLEVÅG, Norge. Main industry is Manufacture of sports goods (32.300); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Bjørn Ove Persgård; Board chair: Bjørn Ove Persgård. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 3.14 m, operating profit NOK 634.28 k, net profit NOK 428.04 k, equity NOK 683.84 k, total assets NOK 2.03 m.
